title: Why Koreans never pick the last persimmon 🥺
description:
In Korea, we leave the last persimmons on the tree for the birds. We call it kkachi-bap, "the magpie's share."

Grandma taught her. Now she teaches her son.

In Korea, the magpie is the bird that brings good news 🐦
